operationSets.name: ProblemActions
operationSets.comment:
A problem's seats and status operations (D104), for any signed-in
caller: the core decides who sits in each seat and who moves the problem.

operations.name: seatsTakeSeat
operations.comment: Seats a subject in a seat: the caller, with the seat's take permission when it names one, or another, with its assign permission. A full seat refuses it, or unseats the subject seated longest when its onFull is displace. A subject seated already is answered unchanged.

docs.title: Problem seats: take seat
docs.description: Seats a subject in a seat: the caller, with the seat's take permission when it names one, or another, with its assign permission. A full seat refuses it, or unseats the subject seated longest when its onFull is displace. A subject seated already is answered unchanged.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: seatsLeaveSeat
operations.comment: Unseats a subject from a seat: the caller, which needs no permission, or another, with the seat's assign permission. The subject the seat's fromField holds cannot leave while it holds them. A subject not seated is answered unchanged.

docs.title: Problem seats: leave seat
docs.description: Unseats a subject from a seat: the caller, which needs no permission, or another, with the seat's assign permission. The subject the seat's fromField holds cannot leave while it holds them. A subject not seated is answered unchanged.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: seatsListSeats
operations.comment: Lists the subjects seated on the row, by seat in code point order, each seat's fromField subject first and then the others in the order they were seated; with seat, only its subjects.

docs.title: Problem seats: list seats
docs.description: Lists the subjects seated on the row, by seat in code point order, each seat's fromField subject first and then the others in the order they were seated; with seat, only its subjects.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: statusTransition
operations.comment: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

docs.title: Problem status: transition
docs.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operationSets.name: SandboxActions
operationSets.comment:
A sandbox's status and observation operations (D104), for any signed-in
caller: the core decides how an observation moves the sandbox.

operations.name: statusTransition
operations.comment: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

docs.title: Sandbox status: transition
docs.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Sandbox row the operation runs on.

operations.name: observedObserve
operations.comment: Records the state the provider reports, when at is newer than the last observation's, and moves the Workflow there along the fewest transitions its config allows, each as the caller, so every guard and permission holds each step; a step refused stops there and records drift. An observation no newer is answered unchanged. Needs observePermission.

docs.title: Sandbox observed: observe
docs.description: Records the state the provider reports, when at is newer than the last observation's, and moves the Workflow there along the fewest transitions its config allows, each as the caller, so every guard and permission holds each step; a step refused stops there and records drift. An observation no newer is answered unchanged. Needs observePermission.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Sandbox row the operation runs on.

workers.name: SandboxDeadlines
workers.comment:
Runs Sandbox's stale deadlines as they fall due (D104): a sandbox no
observation has reached for five minutes moves to unreachable. The
worker fixture-seats-api-sandbox-deadlines.
